sayLines: Travel 1 tile to meadow.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
Something moves out there — the absence of sound, shaped like wings.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
Cold, clear, moving. The best thing you've seen all day.
Movement — crayfish under every second rock.
👁 Grab it right behind the claws, fast. It pinches.
✅ You saw the creek. Niamh nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
Something moves out there — the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still.
Something big pads at the edge of the clearing — then thinks better of it. This ground is already claimed.
Movement — a great horned owl, silent and huge.
👁 It waits for YOU to come close — the stillness is the trap. Spot the shape before you're in reach, and strike first. It only gets one.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.
Movement — a snapping turtle the size of a manhole cover.
👁 Do NOT grab this one. The beak is real. Ranged, or a trap.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with ink-stained fingers telling A woman, maybe 20s, with a slouched posture about Ingrid. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.

Travel 1 tile to meadow.
— Open ground —
The grass is bent in a long smooth run, like something heavy slid through it. You walk the other way around.
It followed you. Something wearing a crown of bone is here.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
A kingfisher works the far bank, patient as a tax collector. It catches something silver and is gone before you can envy it properly.
Something moves out there — stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you.
✅ You saw the creek. Marcus nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 10 people, 5 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 5 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —

The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Where the trail crosses bare rock, someone scratched a mark — an arrow, or a tally, or a prayer. Pre-Burn. You add nothing. You remember it.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 12 people, 5 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 60s telling A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
